verify.note: Closed 2026-09-29 (ADR-1643). Fails when: there is no app/api/v1 route; a route skips authorizeCaller (unless marked public-endpoint:), skips rateLimited, or builds its own Response; lib/contract/index.ts imports anything but zod or loses a status for a core error code; lib/contract/caller.ts stops reading the Authorization header or verifying with auth.getUser(token), stops sharing callerFromViewerRow / getCallerProfile, or reaches the service role; lib/auth.ts resolveCaller stops building through callerFromViewerRow; responses lose Frequency-Contract or no-store, or open CORS; the proxy matcher (evaluated as a regex) matches /api/v1 or stops matching /feed and /api/viewer; the contract tests stop driving a bearer caller, a refusal and the cookie path; or docs/APP-CONTRACT.md loses Bearer, CORS, update_required or v2. Fails on main bc1913405 (no /api/v1 route).

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1643). Re-tested on main at bc1913405 first (ADR-1082): no app/api/v1, no lib/contract, no route reading a bearer token, and the proxy ran on every /api path. SHIPPED. (1) lib/contract/index.ts: the shared types and zod schemas (CONTRACT_VERSION 1, the { data, error } envelope, nine stable error codes with their statuses, MeView); it imports zod only so the Expo app can compile against it. (2) lib/contract/caller.ts authorizeCaller: Authorization: Bearer <supabase access token> verified by supabase.auth.getUser(token) on lib/supabase/bearer.ts (anon key plus the token, RLS, never the service role), else the web cookie through getCallerProfile(); both build the caller through callerFromViewerRow, extracted unchanged from lib/auth.ts resolveCaller, so a bearer and a cookie caller for the same row are the same CallerProfile. A present header decides (a bad token is 401 even beside a valid cookie), an Auth outage is internal not 401, no profile is profile_required, view-as never applies to a bearer caller, and a cookie write needs a same-origin Origin (CSRF) while a bearer write does not. (3) lib/contract/respond.ts: ok / fail with Frequency-Contract: 1, no-store, Vary, no CORS; readInput over parseInput; rateLimited through lib/rate-limit.ts before any credential work (300/min per address per endpoint, allow when unconfigured). (4) GET /api/v1/me, the worked example. (5) proxy.ts matcher skips api/v1, so a native request gets no marker, consent or first-touch cookies and no redirect. (6) docs/APP-CONTRACT.md: auth, envelope, error table, CORS closed, rate limits, adding an endpoint, versioning and deprecation (additive in v1, breaking is v2 beside it, retire only after LIVE-722's min version passes). Capabilities are not on /me: load-capabilities resolves from the cookie, so the bearer projection is LIVE-717. No migration, no dependency, nothing new reachable from app-shell. TESTS: lib/contract/caller.test.ts, lib/contract/contract.test.ts, app/api/v1/me/route.test.ts; each mutation of the fallback, outage, CSRF, mapping, proxy, header and route arms fails them. Filed as ledger fragments (ADR-1635).
